sourceNotes: The swarm’s Telepathic Shroud covers all divination spells. The same block lists Detect Thoughts and Comprehend Languages, both self-range divinations, with no explicit self-cast exception. Both printed rules are retained.
The 2014 Command language and harmful-order restrictions still apply. Volo grants component-free casting and separately lists telepathy 30 ft.
